name: energy-state-analyzer
description: Visualize code energy states in real-time (Python, F#, TypeScript, Kotlin, C++)

commands.title: Energy State Analyzer: Analyze Energy State
Energy State Analyzer: Export SARIF Report

energyStateAnalyzer.includeTestFiles.description: Also flag magic numbers and magic strings in test files (test_*.py, *_test.py, *Test.py, *.test.ts, etc.). Off by default because test code is full of intentional literals.

energyStateAnalyzer.magicString.enabled.description: Whether to flag magic strings (string literals compared, checked for membership, or used as a dict/object key).

energyStateAnalyzer.includeFixtures.description: Analyze files that .esaignore excludes when opened in the editor, for visually verifying detector fixtures. Does not affect the CLI/CI scan, which always honors .esaignore.

energyStateAnalyzer.nesting.enabled.description: Whether to flag deeply nested control-flow blocks (nesting detector). Thresholds are set in .esaconfig.json.

energyStateAnalyzer.cyclomaticComplexity.description: Whether to flag functions by cyclomatic complexity. Thresholds are set in .esaconfig.json.

energyStateAnalyzer.cognitiveComplexity..description: Whether to flag functions by cognitive complexity. Thresholds are set in .esaconfig.json.

energyStateAnalyzer.coherence.enabled.description: Whether to flag file coherence problems (function-count sprawl, god classes). Thresholds are set in .esaconfig.json.

energyStateAnalyzer.matchOpportunity.ena.description: Whether to flag repeated conditional chains that can become match/switch expressions. Thresholds are set in .esaconfig.json.

energyStateAnalyzer.parameterCount.enabl.description: Whether to flag functions with too many parameters. Thresholds are set in .esaconfig.json.

energyStateAnalyzer.primitiveObsession.e.description: Whether to flag primitive obsession (too many primitive arguments or returns in a function).

energyStateAnalyzer.opaqueBoolean.enable.description: Whether to flag opaque booleans/literals used directly in conditionals instead of a named constant.

energyStateAnalyzer.logicalControlFlow.e.description: Whether to flag repeated or inverted boolean expressions across adjacent control-flow branches (logical control flow).

energyStateAnalyzer.inversion.enabled.description: Whether to flag inversion opportunities where a condition's structure could be simplified by inverting it.

energyStateAnalyzer.errorShadowing.enabl.description: Whether to flag overly broad protected try regions or recovery/cleanup that dominates a function.

energyStateAnalyzer.colors.highEnergy.description: Color for high-energy violations (background tint, gutter icon, and complexity heatmap). Defaults to a deep amber so it reads as 'hot' rather than duplicating the red used for compiler/lint errors.

energyStateAnalyzer.colors.mediumEnergy.description: Color for medium-energy violations (background tint and gutter icon).

energyStateAnalyzer.colors.lowEnergy.description: Color for low-energy violations (background tint and gutter icon).

energyStateAnalyzer.colors.backgroundOpa.description: Opacity of the background tint applied behind flagged lines.

scripts.fable: rm -rf fable-out && dotnet fable src/EnergyState.fsproj --lang javascript --outDir fable-out/extension --noCache && dotnet fable cli/EnergyState.Cli.fsproj --lang javascript --outDir fable-out/cli --noCache
scripts.fable-tests: rm -rf fable-tests && dotnet fable tests/EnergyState.Tests.fsproj --lang javascript --outDir fable-tests --noCache && echo '{"type":"module"}' > fable-tests/package.json
scripts.watch: npm run compile && (dotnet fable watch src/EnergyState.fsproj --lang javascript --outDir fable-out/extension --noCache --runWatch npx webpack & dotnet fable watch cli/EnergyState.Cli.fsproj --lang javascript --outDir fable-out/cli --noCache)
scripts.package: rm -rf dist && npm run fable && webpack --mode production --devtool hidden-source-map
